items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I used to listen to Ted Husing on Saturday mornings, the old famous sportscaster.

ctx.x: You played drums when you came here?

Not jazz. I played in the fireman’s band and the high school bands and the marching bands. But it wasn’t until I came here that I played jazz. I loved jazz but it was always listening to recordings. I used to listen to Ted Husing on Saturday mornings, the old famous sportscaster.
